verdict.rationale: Jitsu's Live Events view shows function logs, warehouse batch statuses, streaming delivery results and dead-lettered events, and these can be exported in near real time as OTLP to Datadog, Grafana or similar stacks. It also offers a functions debugger, dead-letter replay, and Email/Slack alerts when warehouse batch or connector sync jobs fail or recover. missing for 10: explicit per-destination delivery metrics dashboards (counts, rates, latency), alerting for streaming-destination delivery failures (only batch/sync failures are documented), in-depth first-party docs on Live Events beyond changelog mentions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
